transcript.speaker: clinician1
transcript.text: Have you been losing your keys lately?

transcript.speaker: patient1
transcript.text: No. I don't lose my keys.

transcript.speaker: patient1
transcript.text: I missed one last year, when I was traveling.

transcript.speaker: caretaker1
transcript.text: She forgot her medication twice last month.

transcript.speaker: patient1
transcript.text: That was only while I had the flu. I'm fine now.

assessment.label: Memory
assessment.text: The caregiver reported two medication lapses last month. The patient frequently loses their keys. They missed appointments throughout the past year. The patient has trouble at work. This meets criterion A for a memory disorder.
